description: This file defines the interface for a queue implementation in C, including functions for creating, pushing, popping, and destroying a queue, with include guards and licensing information.

methods.name: createQ
methods.description: Creates a new queue and outputs its handle.

methods.name: pushToQ
methods.description: Pushes data onto the specified queue.

methods.name: popFromQ
methods.description: Pops data from the specified queue.

methods.name: destroyQ
methods.description: Destroys the specified queue and releases resources.
